violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: milk carton at 58F, single-serving cream cheese 70F, string cheese 59F, yogurt parfait 58F double panned on cold rail.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. CFM discarded all foods.

out_items.name: Single-use/single-service articles properly stored and used

violations.title: Single-Service/Use Items Storage and Handling
violations.observation: Single-service forks were found handled, displayed or dispensed with the food or lip-contact surface facing upward at the cafeteria line and at the utensil table in the dining area.
violations.corrective_action: Single-service items and cleaned/sanitized utensils shall be handled, displayed, and dispensed so that contamination of food and lip contact surfaces are prevented. CFM placed all utensils with handle facing upward.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Sink, Designated Use
violations.observation: Observed the handsink in the kitchen being used to rinse broccoli
violations.corrective_action: Handsinks are to be used only for washing hands to encourage proper hand washing and to prevent contamination of cleaned hands. EHS EXPLAINED TO EMPLOYEES THAT THE HAND WASHING SINK IS ONLY FOR HAND WASHING.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Sinks (nos./capacities)
violations.observation: There is not an adequate number of handwashing sinks lavatories on site. OBSERVED THE ONLY HAND SINK HAS FALLEN OFF OF THE WALL.
violations.corrective_action: At least one hand washing sink, a number of hand washing sinks necessary for their convenient use by employees in areas specified under 5-204.11 and not fewer than the number of hand washing sinks required by Law shall be provided. PIC WILL HAVE HQND SINK REPAIRED WITHIN 10 DAYS.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Signage
violations.observation: Observed that a sign or poster that notifies food employees to wash their hands is not provided at the handwashing sink, located in the kitchen, used by food employees.
violations.corrective_action: The CFM placed a hand washing sign at the hand sink during the inspection for compliance.
